name: Feature delivery
description: Brief -> architect -> frontend/backend -> QA -> reviewer. Produces a reviewed patch, test results, and implementation notes.

roles.name: Architect
roles.description: Turns the brief into a bounded technical plan.

roles.name: Frontend developer
roles.description: Implements UI changes within the plan.

roles.name: Backend developer
roles.description: Implements API and data changes within the plan.

roles.name: QA engineer
roles.description: Writes and runs tests against the implementation.

roles.name: Reviewer
roles.description: Reviews the combined patch and notes.

steps.title: Plan {{feature}}
steps.acceptance: Plan names concrete files and interfaces; open questions listed explicitly.
steps.instructions: Read the brief for {{feature}}. Produce a short plan listing files to change, interfaces, data changes, and risks. Do not write code.

steps.title: Implement UI for {{feature}}
steps.acceptance: UI compiles and matches the plan; no unrelated changes.
steps.instructions: Implement the UI part of the plan for {{feature}}. Keep the diff limited to the files named in the plan.

steps.title: Implement backend for {{feature}}
steps.acceptance: API/data changes match the plan; migrations are additive.
steps.instructions: Implement the backend part of the plan for {{feature}}. Keep changes additive and covered by tests.

steps.title: Test {{feature}}
steps.acceptance: Tests run with recorded output; failures reported truthfully.
steps.instructions: Write or extend tests for {{feature}} and run the project test command. Report the exact command and output.

steps.title: Review {{feature}} patch
steps.acceptance: Every changed file inspected; decision recorded with reasons.
steps.instructions: Review the combined diff and test output for {{feature}}. List defects, then accept or reject.

sampleInputs.feature: Saved filters on the board view
